text: 【假期要闻汇总】国庆节假期影响市场的重要资讯有：央行10月8日将开展12000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为3个月；财政部部长蓝佛安称要研究制定针对性强的增量政策，更加注重扩大国内有效需求；普京说中美俄领导人可能在APEC峰会期间举行三方会晤，外交部回应；商务部就法德要求欧盟强化贸易防御等保护主义工具答记者问；特朗普宣布成立“超级智能特别工作组”；美国非农意外“爆冷”，美联储10月加息概率骤降；华为官宣和美国高通达成重磅协议；本年度诺贝尔奖陆续揭晓，多家公司布局相关赛道。
text_en: [Holiday News Roundup] Important market-moving news during the National Day holiday included: the PBOC will conduct 1.2 trillion yuan of outright reverse repurchase operations on October 8 with a term of 3 months; Finance Minister Lan Fo'an said targeted incremental policies should be studied and formulated, with greater emphasis on expanding effective domestic demand; Putin said the leaders of China, the US and Russia may hold trilateral talks during the APEC summit, and the Foreign Ministry responded; the Commerce Ministry answered questions on France and Germany urging the EU to strengthen protectionist tools such as trade defenses; Trump announced the creation of a "Super Intelligence Task Force"; US nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly came in weak, sharply lowering the probability of a Fed rate hike in October; Huawei officially announced a major agreement with US-based Qualcomm; this year's Nobel Prizes were announced one after another, with many companies positioning in related sectors.
